_comment: DRISHTI cost-safety descriptor (Phase 14 Part B + Part J scoping). Catalyst exposes NO CLI billing/usage command and the CLI login carries no billing scope (verified Part A, report §9), so Catalyst budget alerts + usage reports are configured in Console -> Billing/Budget; AWS cost safety uses AWS Budgets + CloudWatch. This file is the reviewed source an operator applies. No monetary values are secret; amounts are the hackathon plan baseline. Part J keeps a SMALL, robust set of cost controls; the exact 50/75/90% Catalyst alert automation is OPTIONAL (only if the Console makes it straightforward).
kept_cost_safety_J: Confirm the Catalyst credit balance before + after enabling any paid capability (Console -> Billing).
Avoid duplicate AppSail apps / services / jobs (one drishti-api AppSail; one prediction.requested Signal; one forecast cron).
Conservative resource sizing (AppSail 1-2 instances; SageMaker async scale-to-zero; dev Data Store imports capped).
An AWS budget alarm (AWS Budgets + CloudWatch) for the AWS side.
Stop GPU resources after testing (delete the SageMaker async endpoint).

avoid_duplicates.note: Before creating anything, check it does not already exist. Exactly one of each above; everything else stays OFF (DRISHTI_*_ENABLED).

conservative_sizing: SageMaker: ONE async endpoint, scale-to-zero (min_capacity=0) — GPU cost only during a run.
Development Data Store imports capped at 5000 rows/table.

budget_alarm.action: email owner; the SageMaker endpoint is the only standing GPU cost — delete it (see cleanup).
budget_alarm.note: AWS Budgets IS straightforward, so the AWS alarm is kept.

aws_cost_safety.no_static_credentials: SageMaker + the adapter use IAM roles; no access keys are stored.
aws_cost_safety.stop_gpu_after_testing: python infra/aws/gpu-worker/deploy_gpu_worker.py --teardown  (then aws sagemaker delete-endpoint --endpoint-name drishti-gpu-async)

catalyst_budget_alerts_inr._optional_note: OPTIONAL (Part J): the exact 50/75/90% Catalyst alert automation is applied in Console -> Budget only if it is straightforward; otherwise rely on confirming the credit balance manually + the AWS alarm. These thresholds are the intended values if enabled.

thresholds.action: email owner; pause non-essential enable flags (DRISHTI_*_ENABLED)
email owner; stop temporary AWS GPU; freeze new deploys

cleanup: Stop GPU: python infra/aws/gpu-worker/deploy_gpu_worker.py --teardown ; aws sagemaker delete-endpoint --endpoint-name drishti-gpu-async (+ delete-endpoint-config).
Turn OFF every DRISHTI_*_ENABLED flag on AppSail so no Signal/cron/RAG fires.
Confirm no duplicate AppSail apps / Signals rules / crons were left active (see avoid_duplicates).
AWS: leave the ECR image + versioned S3 model artifacts (cheap, immutable) for a later redeploy; delete only if fully done.
Confirm the Catalyst credit balance in Console -> Billing after the demo.
Temporary S3 async I/O objects expire via lifecycle; verify the async output/failure prefixes are empty.
review_cadence: Confirm the credit balance before/after enabling paid capabilities; the optional cron_reconcile can attach a nightly budget/health evidence line if enabled.
